notes: The only chain in the report sits after the Quranic verses and the commentary: «روى ذلك المفضل بن صالح عن زيد الشحام عن أبي عبد الله» ; it is read as the report's chain
The Imam is written inside the chain after «عن»: narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The clause «فإذا نشزت المرأة» carries no chain of its own; the Quranic verses are not names
